entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A sadistic interplanar menace and planeswalker who revels in the suffering of others; born human on Innistrad, transformed into a half-devil.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Tibalt was born human.

events.summary: Tibalt, born human on Innistrad, explores fiendish magic out of fascination with pain and is transformed into a half-devil.
events.quote: his fascination with pain drove him to explore fiendish magic that ultimately transformed him into a half-devil.
